activity_summary: At home you said the three nights over. Stephen is the Navarre comedy. John is the lovers, and the second night is Burbage's, for a house that has supped. Innocents is Errors. The wood-play was not offered. It is three pages and a speech, and it is not made ready by being wanted. The hose have no sum. The money is not in the house. Clerkenwell is the sixteenth. The undertaking stands.
